ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.name: Account Takeover
ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.description: Unauthorized access or SIM swap where an unrecognized hardware device accesses the wallet and rapidly initiates high-value transfers or balance depletion.

MULE_NETWORK.name: Mule Network
MULE_NETWORK.description: Multi-hop layering relay chains, circular cycles, or coordinated mule syndicates distributing illicit funds across intermediate wallets.

SMURFING.name: Smurfing / Transaction Splitting
SMURFING.description: Structuring multiple below-threshold inflows into a single aggregator account to evade regulatory reporting thresholds.

SOCIAL_ENGINEERING.name: Social Engineering
SOCIAL_ENGINEERING.description: Victim manipulated into transferring funds via fake lottery, impersonation, or erroneous transfer ('ভুল করে টাকা গেছে') scams.

AGENT_CASHOUT_ABUSE.name: Agent Cash-out Abuse
AGENT_CASHOUT_ABUSE.description: Rapid liquidity drain or collusive high-volume liquidation through an agent POS cash-out point exceeding baseline limits.

NOCTURNAL_CASHOUT.name: Nocturnal Cash-out
NOCTURNAL_CASHOUT.description: High-value cash-out executed during dead hours (01:00 AM – 05:00 AM) deviating sharply from daytime baseline.

RAPID_FUND_MOVEMENT.name: Rapid Fund Movement
RAPID_FUND_MOVEMENT.description: High-velocity bursts of transfers with minimal account resting time between inbound and outbound flows.
